major-00-the-fool.alt: The Fool tarot card. A carefree young traveler steps toward the edge of a high cliff, face lifted to the sky, holding a white rose, a small bundle on a staff over one shoulder, a little white dog leaping at their heels beneath a radiant sun.

major-01-the-magician.alt: The Magician tarot card. A robed magician stands behind a stone table, one hand raising a double-tipped wand to the sky and the other pointing to the earth, an infinity sign glowing above their head and a cup, sword, pentacle and wand laid on the table, framed by roses and lilies.

major-02-the-high-priestess.alt: The High Priestess tarot card. A serene priestess in flowing blue and ivory robes sits between a dark pillar and a pale pillar, wearing a horned moon crown, a scroll half-hidden in her lap and a crescent moon at her feet, before a veil embroidered with pomegranates.

major-03-the-empress.alt: The Empress tarot card. A crowned empress reclines on a cushioned throne in a lush garden, a heart-shaped shield bearing the Venus symbol beside her, golden wheat at her feet and a waterfall flowing from a cypress forest behind.

major-04-the-emperor.alt: The Emperor tarot card. A stern bearded emperor sits on a stone throne carved with ram heads, armor beneath a burgundy robe, holding an ankh scepter and a golden orb before barren mountains.

major-05-the-hierophant.alt: The Hierophant tarot card. A robed spiritual teacher in a triple crown sits between two grey pillars, one hand raised in blessing and the other holding a triple cross, crossed keys at their feet and two acolytes kneeling before them.

major-06-the-lovers.alt: The Lovers tarot card. A winged angel spreads its arms above the clouds before a radiant sun, blessing a man and a woman who stand below, a fruit tree with a coiled serpent behind her and a tree of flames behind him, a mountain peak rising between them.

major-07-the-chariot.alt: The Chariot tarot card. An armored charioteer stands in a stone chariot beneath a star-spangled canopy, a black sphinx and a white sphinx resting before it, a walled city and river behind.

major-08-strength.alt: Strength tarot card. A gentle woman in an ivory robe crowned with flowers calmly closes the jaws of a lion, an infinity sign glowing above her head, mountains behind.

major-09-the-hermit.alt: The Hermit tarot card. A cloaked grey-bearded elder stands alone on a snowy mountain peak at night, holding up a lantern that contains a shining six-pointed star and leaning on a tall staff.

major-10-wheel-of-fortune.alt: Wheel of Fortune tarot card. A great golden wheel inscribed with alchemical symbols turns in the clouds, a sphinx with a sword seated on top, a serpent descending one side and a jackal-headed figure rising on the other, four winged creatures reading books in the corners.

major-11-justice.alt: Justice tarot card. A crowned figure in a burgundy robe sits between two stone pillars, holding an upright double-edged sword in one hand and balanced golden scales in the other, a veil hanging behind.

major-12-the-hanged-man.alt: The Hanged Man tarot card. A serene man hangs upside down by one foot from a living T-shaped tree, his other leg bent behind to form a cross, hands behind his back and a golden halo around his head.

major-13-death.alt: Death tarot card. A skeletal knight in dark armor rides a white horse carrying a black banner marked with a white rose, a fallen king beneath the hooves, a bishop, a maiden and a child before it, the sun rising between two towers on the horizon.

major-14-temperance.alt: Temperance tarot card. A winged angel in an ivory robe pours water between two cups, one foot on land and one in a pool, irises blooming beside them and a path winding to mountains crowned with light.

major-15-the-devil.alt: The Devil tarot card. A horned, bat-winged devil with goat features crouches on a dark pedestal, one hand raised and the other holding a lowered torch, a horned man and woman loosely chained to the pedestal below.

major-16-the-tower.alt: The Tower tarot card. A tall stone tower on a rocky crag is struck by lightning at night, its crown blasted from the top, flames bursting from the windows and two figures falling headlong.

major-17-the-star.alt: The Star tarot card. A kneeling woman pours water from two jugs, one into a still pool and one onto the land, beneath a great eight-pointed star circled by seven smaller stars, an ibis perched in a tree behind.

major-18-the-moon.alt: The Moon tarot card. A full moon with a crescent and a solemn face sheds drops of light over a dog and a wolf howling beside a pool, a crayfish emerging from the water and a path winding between two towers toward distant mountains.

major-19-the-sun.alt: The Sun tarot card. A radiant sun with a calm face shines over a joyful child riding a white horse, arms spread wide and holding a burgundy banner, sunflowers peeking over a garden wall behind.

major-20-judgement.alt: Judgement tarot card. A great angel in the clouds blows a trumpet hung with a banner bearing a red cross, while grey figures rise from open coffins below with arms outstretched, mountains and sea behind.

major-21-the-world.alt: The World tarot card. A dancing figure wrapped in a flowing sash holds two wands inside a great laurel wreath bound with ribbons, with an angel, an eagle, a lion and a bull watching from the four corners.

wands-01-ace.alt: Ace of Wands tarot card. A hand emerges from a cloud grasping a sprouting wooden wand, leaves drifting down, a castle on a hill in the distance.

wands-02-two.alt: Two of Wands tarot card. A man in a burgundy cloak stands on castle battlements holding a small globe and a wand, gazing out over sea and land, a second wand fixed to the wall.

wands-03-three.alt: Three of Wands tarot card. A figure seen from behind stands on a cliff beside three planted wands, watching ships sail across a golden sea.

wands-04-four.alt: Four of Wands tarot card. Four wands hung with a garland of flowers and fruit form a canopy, two figures raising bouquets in celebration before a castle.

wands-05-five.alt: Five of Wands tarot card. Five young figures brandish wands at one another in a spirited mock battle on open ground.

wands-06-six.alt: Six of Wands tarot card. A laurel-crowned rider on a white horse carries a wand topped with a wreath through a crowd raising their own wands.

wands-07-seven.alt: Seven of Wands tarot card. A determined figure on high ground fends off six wands rising from below with a single wand, wearing mismatched shoes.

wands-08-eight.alt: Eight of Wands tarot card. Eight wands fly in parallel through the air over open countryside with a river and a hill.

wands-09-nine.alt: Nine of Wands tarot card. A weary figure with a bandaged head leans on a wand, eight more wands standing behind like a palisade.

wands-10-ten.alt: Ten of Wands tarot card. A figure bends forward under the weight of ten wands carried in a bundle toward a distant town.

wands-11-page.alt: Page of Wands tarot card. A youth in a feathered cap and a tunic patterned with salamanders holds a tall wand, studying it in a desert with distant pyramids.

wands-12-knight.alt: Knight of Wands tarot card. A knight in armor and a salamander-patterned tunic rides a rearing horse, wand raised, distant pyramids behind.

wands-13-queen.alt: Queen of Wands tarot card. A queen sits on a lion-carved throne holding a wand and a sunflower, a black cat seated at her feet.

wands-14-king.alt: King of Wands tarot card. A king on a throne decorated with lions and salamanders holds a flowering wand, a small salamander at his feet.

cups-01-ace.alt: Ace of Cups tarot card. A hand emerges from a cloud holding a chalice that overflows in five streams into a lily pond, a dove descending with a wafer toward the cup.

cups-02-two.alt: Two of Cups tarot card. A young man and woman exchange cups and pledge, a caduceus crowned with a winged lion's head rising between them.

cups-03-three.alt: Three of Cups tarot card. Three women dance in a circle raising their cups in a garden full of harvest fruit.

cups-04-four.alt: Four of Cups tarot card. A young man sits beneath a tree with arms crossed, contemplating three cups before him while a hand from a cloud offers a fourth.

cups-05-five.alt: Five of Cups tarot card. A figure in a dark cloak mourns over three spilled cups while two upright cups stand behind, a bridge leading across a river to a castle.

cups-06-six.alt: Six of Cups tarot card. In an old village courtyard a child offers a cup filled with white flowers to a smaller child, six flower-filled cups around them.

cups-07-seven.alt: Seven of Cups tarot card. A figure seen in silhouette faces seven cups floating on clouds, each holding a vision: a castle, jewels, a laurel wreath, a dragon, a serpent, a veiled glowing figure and a head.

cups-08-eight.alt: Eight of Cups tarot card. A cloaked figure with a staff walks away from eight neatly stacked cups toward rocky mountains under a crescent moon embracing a sun.

cups-09-nine.alt: Nine of Cups tarot card. A contented man sits with arms crossed before a curved, cloth-draped bench holding nine cups in an arc.

cups-10-ten.alt: Ten of Cups tarot card. A couple raises their arms toward a rainbow of ten cups while two children dance, a cottage by a river behind them.

cups-11-page.alt: Page of Cups tarot card. A youth in a floral tunic stands by the sea holding a cup from which a small fish peeks out.

cups-12-knight.alt: Knight of Cups tarot card. A knight in winged helmet rides a calm white horse at a walk, holding a cup forward, a river running through the valley.

cups-13-queen.alt: Queen of Cups tarot card. A queen sits on a throne at the sea's edge carved with cherubs, gazing into an ornate closed chalice.

cups-14-king.alt: King of Cups tarot card. A king on a throne floating on a choppy sea holds a cup and a scepter, a ship and a leaping fish nearby.

swords-01-ace.alt: Ace of Swords tarot card. A hand emerges from a cloud holding an upright sword whose tip passes through a golden crown hung with olive and palm, above jagged mountains.

swords-02-two.alt: Two of Swords tarot card. A blindfolded woman sits on a stone bench with arms crossed over her chest, holding two swords, a rocky sea and crescent moon behind her.

swords-03-three.alt: Three of Swords tarot card. A heart pierced by three swords hangs against storm clouds and slanting rain.

swords-04-four.alt: Four of Swords tarot card. The effigy of a knight lies on a tomb in a quiet chapel, hands joined in prayer, three swords on the wall above and one along the tomb, a stained-glass window nearby.

swords-05-five.alt: Five of Swords tarot card. A smirking figure gathers swords while two defeated figures walk away toward the sea under a torn, windy sky.

swords-06-six.alt: Six of Swords tarot card. A ferryman poles a boat carrying a cloaked woman and child toward a calm far shore, six swords standing upright in the boat.

swords-07-seven.alt: Seven of Swords tarot card. A figure tiptoes away from a camp of tents carrying five swords, glancing back at two swords left planted in the ground.

swords-08-eight.alt: Eight of Swords tarot card. A bound and blindfolded woman stands in marshy ground surrounded by eight swords, a castle on a cliff behind.

swords-09-nine.alt: Nine of Swords tarot card. A figure sits up in bed with face buried in their hands, nine swords stacked horizontally on the dark wall, a quilt patterned with roses and astrological signs.

swords-10-ten.alt: Ten of Swords tarot card. A figure lies face down pierced by ten swords beneath a dark sky, while dawn breaks gold over still water on the horizon.

swords-11-page.alt: Page of Swords tarot card. A youth stands on a windswept hill holding a sword upright with both hands, birds scattering through billowing clouds.

swords-12-knight.alt: Knight of Swords tarot card. A knight charges at full gallop on a white horse, sword raised, through wind-bent trees and racing clouds.

swords-13-queen.alt: Queen of Swords tarot card. A queen sits in profile on a throne carved with butterflies, holding an upright sword with one hand and extending the other, a single bird high in the sky.

swords-14-king.alt: King of Swords tarot card. A king sits facing forward on a throne carved with butterflies, holding an upright sword slightly tilted, cypress trees and birds behind.

pentacles-01-ace.alt: Ace of Pentacles tarot card. A hand emerges from a cloud holding a great golden pentacle above a garden of lilies, a hedge archway opening onto distant mountains.

pentacles-02-two.alt: Two of Pentacles tarot card. A young man in a tall hat dances while juggling two pentacles bound by an infinity loop, ships riding high waves behind him.

pentacles-03-three.alt: Three of Pentacles tarot card. A stonemason on a bench works in a cathedral arch while a monk and a robed patron hold plans and confer, three pentacles carved in the arch.

pentacles-04-four.alt: Four of Pentacles tarot card. A crowned figure sits clutching a pentacle to their chest, another balanced on their crown and two beneath their feet, a city behind.

pentacles-05-five.alt: Five of Pentacles tarot card. Two ragged figures, one on crutches, trudge through falling snow past a glowing stained-glass window showing five pentacles.

pentacles-06-six.alt: Six of Pentacles tarot card. A merchant holding balanced scales gives coins to two kneeling figures, six pentacles floating around them.

pentacles-07-seven.alt: Seven of Pentacles tarot card. A farmer leans on a hoe gazing thoughtfully at seven pentacles growing on a leafy vine.

pentacles-08-eight.alt: Eight of Pentacles tarot card. A craftsman sits at a workbench carving a pentacle, finished pentacles hung on a post beside them, a town in the distance.

pentacles-09-nine.alt: Nine of Pentacles tarot card. An elegant woman in a robe patterned with sunflowers stands in a lush vineyard with a hooded falcon on her gloved hand, nine pentacles among the vines.

pentacles-10-ten.alt: Ten of Pentacles tarot card. An elderly patriarch in a patterned robe sits beneath an archway with two white dogs, a couple and a child nearby, ten pentacles arranged across the scene.

pentacles-11-page.alt: Page of Pentacles tarot card. A youth stands in a green field holding a pentacle up before their eyes, studying it, a ploughed field and trees behind.

pentacles-12-knight.alt: Knight of Pentacles tarot card. A knight sits motionless on a heavy black horse holding a pentacle, overlooking freshly ploughed fields.

pentacles-13-queen.alt: Queen of Pentacles tarot card. A queen sits on a throne carved with goat heads and fruit in a bower of roses, cradling a pentacle in her lap, a rabbit at her feet.

pentacles-14-king.alt: King of Pentacles tarot card. A king in a robe patterned with grapevines sits on a bull-carved throne holding a pentacle and scepter, a castle behind.
